en: 4. The Pairs on the Elements (Dhātuyamaka) 4.1.
The Section on Designations (Paṇṇattivāra) 4.1.1.
The Summary of the Section on Designations (Paṇṇattivāra-uddesa)
Homage to that Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Perfectly Self-Awakened One.

There are eighteen elements: the eye element, the ear element, the nose element, the tongue element, the body element, the form element, the sound element, the odor element, the taste element, the tangible-object element, the eye-consciousness element, the ear-consciousness element, [the nose-consciousness element, the tongue-consciousness element, the body-consciousness element, the mind-consciousness element, the mind-element, and the dhamma-element].
The nose-consciousness element, the tongue-consciousness element, the body-consciousness element, the mind element, the mind-consciousness element, and the mental-object element.
4.1.1.1. Section on Purification of Terms 4.1.1.1.1.
Positive Order (Anuloma)
Is the eye the eye-element?
Is the eye-element the eye?
Is the ear the ear-element?
Is the ear-element the ear?
… [as above] … Is eye-consciousness the eye-consciousness-element?
Is the eye-consciousness-element eye-consciousness? … [as above] …
Is mind the mind-element?
Is the mind-element the mind?
Is mind-consciousness the mind-consciousness-element?
Is the mind-consciousness element mind-consciousness?
Is the mental object the mental-object-element?
Is the mental-object-element a mental object?
4.1.1.1.2. Negative (Paccanīka):
Is it not the eye, yet not the eye-element?
Is it not the eye-element, yet not the eye?
Is it not the ear, yet not the ear-element?
Is it not the ear-element, yet not the ear?
…pe… Is it not eye-consciousness, yet not the eye-consciousness-element?
Is it not the eye-consciousness element, yet not eye-consciousness?
…pe… Is it not the mind, yet not the mind-element?
Is it not the mind-element, yet not the mind?
Is it not mental consciousness, yet not the element of mental consciousness?
Is it not the element of mental consciousness, yet not mental consciousness?
Is it not a phenomenon, yet not the element of phenomena?
Is it not the dhammadhātu and yet not dhamma?
4.1.1.2. Wheel-Section Based on the Purification of Terms (Padasodhanamūlacakkavāra) 4.1.1.2.1.
Positive Order (Anuloma)
Is the eye the eye-element?
Is the element the ear-element?
…pe… Is the eye the eye-element?
Are the elements the dhamma-element?
(The wheel should be constructed here in the same manner as it was constructed in the *Āyatana-yamaka*. 4.1.1.2.2.
Negative Order (*Paccanīka*)
Is it not the eye, yet not the eye-element?
Is it not an element, yet not the ear-element?
Is it not the eye, yet not the eye-element?
Is it not an element, yet not the nose-element?
…pe… Is it not the eye, yet not the eye-element?
Is it not an element, yet not the mental-object-element? …pe…
Is it not the case that what is not *dhamma* is not the *dhammadhātu*?
Is it not the case that what is not an element (*dhātu*) is not the eye-element (*cakkhudhātu*)? …pe… Is it not the case that what is not *dhamma* is not the *dhammadhātu*?
Is it not a *dhātu* and not the mind-consciousness-element?
(The wheel should be drawn here.
4.1.1.3. The Section on Pure Elements (*Suddhadhātuvāra*).
4.1.1.3.1. Positive (Anuloma):
Is it the eye element? Is it the eye?
Is the ear an element? Is the ear an element?

Is the nose an element? … pe … Is the tongue an element? … Is the body an element? … Is visible form an element? … Is sound an element? … Is odor an element? … Is flavor an element? … Is tangible object an element? …
Is eye-consciousness an element?
Is the element eye-consciousness?
Is ear-consciousness an element?
Is the ear-element ear-consciousness?
… nose-consciousness? … tongue-consciousness? … body-consciousness? Is the mind-element [mind-consciousness]?
Is the element mind?
Is it the mind-consciousness element?
Is the element mind-consciousness?
Is the Dhamma an element (dhātu)?
Are the elements the Dhamma?
4.1.1.3.2. Negative (Paccanīka)
Is it not the eye, yet not the element?
Is it not the element, yet not the eye?
Is it not the ear, yet not the element?
Is it not an element, yet not the ear?
… Not the nose? … Not the tongue? … Not the body? … Not visible form? … Not sound? … Not odor? … Not flavor? … Not tangible object?
Is eye-consciousness not an element?
Is it not an element, yet not eye-consciousness?
… Not ear-consciousness? … pe … Not nose-consciousness? … Not tongue-consciousness?
Is it not body-consciousness, yet an element?
Is it not the elements and not body-consciousness?
Is it not the mind and not the element?
Is it not the elements and not the mind?
Is it not mind-consciousness and yet not an element?
Is it not an element and yet not mind-consciousness?
Is it not a mental phenomenon and yet not an element?
Not element and not phenomenon?
4.1.1.4. Wheel Chapter Based on Pure Elements 4.1.1.4.1.
Positive Order (Anuloma)
Is it the eye element?
Is it the ear element? …pe… Is it the eye element?
Are the elements (dhātu) phenomena (dhamma)?
… [and so on] … Are phenomena elements?
Are the elements the eye? … [and so on] …
Is the Dhamma an element?
Is mind-consciousness an element?
(The wheel should be bound.)
4.1.1.4.2. Negative (Paccanīka) Is it not the eye, yet not the element?
Is it not the element, yet not the ear?
Is it not the eye, yet not a constituent element?
Is it not a constituent element, yet not the nose? ... [and so on] ...
Is it not the eye, yet not a constituent element?
Neither element nor phenomenon? …pe… Neither phenomenon nor element?
Neither element nor eye? …pe…
Is it not a phenomenon (dhamma) and not an element (dhātu)?
Is it not an element and not mind-consciousness (manoviññāṇa)?
(The wheel should be constructed.)
The Section on the Exposition of Designations.
